component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents.reviews
component.documentation: The review cycle listener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires it: opens a review cycle on a current revision its opener may write, one at a time per revision; gives each of Nuxeo's own comments written in it, by a reviewer or the opener, the ReviewComment facet, its thread open; lets the opener resolve a thread, or open it again, while the cycle is open; closes the cycle at its opener's asking only when no thread is open, and records it on the revision, as the opener; refuses every other change, a closed cycle's comments included, and a cycle's deletion and trash but by an administrator. A comment written and a close are kept apart by a fence in the key/value store. No Automation operation. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback.
